name: illustrator-vector-panel
description: CEP vector tracing panel for Adobe Illustrator

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/panel.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=iife --target=chrome99 --outfile=extension/js/panel.js && esbuild src/trace-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node14 --outfile=extension/js/trace-worker.js
